threat_scenario: Connector receives broader account category or time access than the user intended
preventive_control: OS-scoped grant plus in-app category and date controls
verification_evidence: Permission matrix test on every supported OS version
residual_risk: OS APIs may expose coarse scopes
release_gate: No connector ships without documented minimum scope

threat_scenario: A message calendar entry or document contains instructions that manipulate the narrative model
preventive_control: Treat connector content as data; isolate system policy; restrict model tools
verification_evidence: Seeded injection corpus cannot change policy or trigger actions
release_gate: No content-driven external action in MVP

threat_scenario: Another app backup service or device user reads the personal corpus
preventive_control: Per-device encryption key in OS keystore; protected files; backup exclusion
residual_risk: Compromised unlocked OS can expose data
release_gate: Security test passes on device matrix

threat_scenario: Source deletion leaves embeddings entities summaries or narrative claims
preventive_control: Derivation graph and cascading delete or recomputation
verification_evidence: Seeded source disappears from all indexes caches and narratives
residual_risk: External user-created exports cannot be recalled

threat_scenario: Sensitive inference appears on a lock screen
preventive_control: Generic notification text; sensitive content only after local unlock
verification_evidence: Locked-screen snapshot contains no personal content
residual_risk: User may enable broader previews manually
release_gate: Safe preview is default and regression-tested

threat_scenario: A malicious or corrupted model update changes behavior or exfiltrates data
preventive_control: Signed manifest pinned digest offline inference sandbox and rollback
verification_evidence: Tampered artifact rejected; previous model restored
residual_risk: Trusted publisher can still ship harmful behavior

threat_scenario: Crash logs analytics or traces contain raw personal data
preventive_control: Structured logging allowlist; local diagnostics; explicit export
verification_evidence: Secret-seeded workflow leaves no secret in logs
residual_risk: OS-level crash reports may contain metadata

threat_scenario: Future sync leaks data metadata or deletion state across devices
preventive_control: Defer from MVP; later end-to-end encryption device identity conflict and deletion protocol
residual_risk: Traffic analysis and lost-key recovery remain
release_gate: Sync blocked until separate threat model passes

threat_scenario: Partner family member or coercive actor opens narratives
preventive_control: Local biometric gate optional decoy/quick lock and no shared profile by default

threat_scenario: Model presents inference or digital sampling bias as fact
preventive_control: Sentence-level citations inference labels correction and source exclusion
verification_evidence: Unsupported-fact fixture rejected; user correction test
residual_risk: Cited sources may still be incomplete or misleading

threat_scenario: System summarizes another person's messages health or location without consent
preventive_control: Minimize third-party attributes; exclude sensitive inference; user-visible source policy
verification_evidence: Third-party trait test cases are blocked
residual_risk: User-controlled source may lawfully contain third-party data

threat_scenario: Background inference drains battery heats device or causes OS termination
preventive_control: Incremental ingest charging-only synthesis bounded model and quotas
verification_evidence: Battery thermal memory latency and storage tests across device matrix
